messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action in the source video so that they sneeze, following the sneezing motion demonstrated in the motion reference. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's action so that they sneeze, as shown in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands mostly still, shifting her weight slightly and raising her right hand to touch her face and hair before lowering it.","camera":"A static, high-angle full-body shot capturing the character and her long shadow on the ground.","clothing":"A short, colorful dress with a purple, blue, and orange pattern, featuring cut-out shoulders and a deep V-neckline, paired with pink flat shoes.","hair_color":"Pink.","hairstyle":"Bright pink hair styled in a bob with straight bangs and a small ponytail at the back.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build and light skin.","scene":"An outdoor area with a flat, sandy or dirt ground, illuminated by bright sunlight that casts a distinct shadow to the left."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The pink-haired character now faces forward and performs a sneeze-like motion: she raises her hand to her nose/face, bends forward with a sudden head and upper-body jerk, then recovers to standing. The original back-facing pose and hand-behind-head motion were replaced.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action so they sneeze, following the reference motion, while preserving identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
unexpected_changes: The character's initial orientation changed from back-facing to front-facing relative to the source video.
